## method
- file lists: bin/deps.py (module/package resolver over hw/ip/*/rtl, prim_generic, ip_autogen/*/rtl, top_earlgrey rtl, ast, ibex_pkg; macro-instantiated prim_sparse_fsm_flop added); every list: `verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal` = 0 %Error.
- vita page 1 on the ORIGINAL text. Every vita parse refusal stops the whole design, so roots were peeled: minimal repro per root (repros/), then a semantics-preserving workaround in an overlay (patched/, built by bin/mkpatched.py from bin/patches.py + bin/hoist.py + bin/mreg.py) and vita re-run. The overlay is never an oracle input; verilator also runs the overlay (vlp) to show each workaround keeps the DIGEST.
- runs: first-party TL-UL tb (tb/tlhost.svh + tb/tb_<ip>.sv: reset, register reads/writes through tlul_cmd_intg_gen, per-cycle output digest, `DIGEST=` line); tb/tb_prims.sv drives 7 constant-heavy prims with a 200-vector stream. verilator `--x-assign unique --x-initial unique`, seeds 1..5 with `+verilator+rand+reset+{0,1,2,2,2}`.
- a "root" = a distinct mechanism (bisected per file / construct, repro minimised); a diagnostic count is not a root count (uart page 1: 50 E2002 = 3 roots; uart elab: 201 errors, 186 of them one root R08).

## designs
vita(original) = page 1 on upstream text; roots(all) = every root the design hits over the full peel (static: workaround applied to a file in its list; dynamic: diagnostic seen). verilator = lint of the upstream list. iverilog / sv2v->iverilog = first raw line on the upstream list.
